Jacobs & Co Increased Facebook Class A (FB) Holding by $562,701; Market Value Declined; Kazazian Asset Management Has Increased Apple (AAPL) Position by $869,903 as Share Value Rose
June 8, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Kazazian Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 33.78% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kazazian Asset Management Llc bought 5,209 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 20,630 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.46M, up from 15,421 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kazazian Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $950.88 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.27% or $0.52 during the last trading session, reaching $193.46. About 17.13 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
